observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and canonical Store event page

outcome.implementation_change: Added an exclusive event-sequence cursor to the canonical Store event page, Session API, and environmental-capability CLI. Historical projections report the selected page, older-page availability, and a next cursor. Canonical Store reads still scan generation binding metadata but materialize only the selected event payloads.
outcome.observed_pressure: One authenticated session recorded 128 Control read operations while the whole-session projection returned 32 and reported 96 omitted. A live 24-event historical page returned 11 authenticated operations that were absent from a separately queried newest 24-event page.
outcome.analysis_limit: The cursor capability is verified and exercised against one existing session. Reduced agent effort, cross-session recurrence, and the long-term effect on development are not measured.

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

improvement_relation.basis: The bounded Store API, Session projection, CLI cursor, and compact response are covered by targeted regressions and the existing vertical proof. A direct canonical Store read selected sequences 76-99 before sequence 100, returned 11 authenticated read-operation records, and supplied sequence 76 as the next cursor. The default whole-session projection exposed the 32-record output cap and 96 omitted records.
not_measured: whether older-page access reduces repeated investigation across sessions
whether the source session's omitted operations constrained its campaign
long-term recurrence or agent outcome changes
whether the pressure is reduced under future long-running work
